homeHeroLead: Spansules develops, manufactures and packs oral solid dosage medicine for healthcare brands across fourteen markets — with batch-level traceability from raw material to dispatch.
homeCapabilitiesLead: Formulation science, regulated manufacturing and packaging under a single quality system — so nothing is lost in the handover between vendors.
capFormulationDesc: Pre-formulation studies, excipient screening and stability-led design for capsules, tablets and pellets — documented for regulatory filing from day one.
capManufacturingDesc: Twelve lines across granulation, blending, encapsulation and coating, each with in-process controls recorded batch by batch.
capQualityDesc: An in-house GLP laboratory releases every batch: assay, dissolution, uniformity and accelerated stability.
capSupplyDesc: Blister, strip and bulk packing with serialised cartons, cold-chain handling and export documentation prepared in-house.
capContractDesc: Your brand, our lines. Technology transfer, scale-up batches and commercial supply with confidentiality built into the process.

stepEncapsulationDesc: Filling and coating under monitored temperature, humidity and differential pressure.
stepInspectionDesc: Laboratory release on assay, dissolution and appearance, plus retained samples for every batch.
stepDispatchDesc: Serialised packing, documentation and despatch with a full audit trail attached.

aboutHeroLead: We have spent twenty-seven years doing one thing properly: turning approved formulations into medicine that leaves our plant exactly as specified.
aboutStoryP1: Spansules began in 1998 as a two-room formulation lab in Hyderabad, taking on the work larger plants found too small or too particular. That habit of accepting difficult briefs shaped everything that followed.
aboutStoryP2: Today the same team runs twelve production lines and a GLP laboratory, and still reviews every new formulation in the same room where the company started. Scale changed the volumes, not the standard.
aboutStoryP3: We stay deliberately mid-sized. It lets a customer speak to the person who actually made their batch, and it lets us refuse work we cannot do well.
milestoneFoundedDesc: Two formulators, one lab, and contract development work for regional brands.

milestoneCertifiedDesc: Quality systems formalised and the in-house GLP laboratory accredited.
milestoneExportDesc: First shipments to South-East Asia and East Africa, now fourteen markets.
milestoneDigitalDesc: Every stage of production recorded digitally, from vendor intake to dispatch.
aboutValuesLead: These are the reasons we occasionally lose a contract — and the reasons customers stay for a decade.
valueIntegrityDesc: What the batch record says is what happened. No exceptions, no retroactive edits.
valuePrecisionDesc: We will move a delivery date before we will release a batch we are unsure about.
valuePeopleDesc: Most of our line supervisors have been here over a decade. Judgement like that cannot be hired quickly.
valueSustainabilityDesc: Solvent recovery, treated effluent and packaging reduction targets reviewed every year.
aboutQualityLead: Quality is not a final inspection here — it is a series of gates, each one documented.

faqLeadTimeQ: What is a typical lead time?
faqLeadTimeA: Commercial batches of an already transferred formulation dispatch in 18 to 25 days. A new formulation needs 8 to 12 weeks for development, trial batches and stability data before commercial supply.
faqMoqQ: Is there a minimum order quantity?
faqMoqA: Commercial runs usually start at 100,000 capsules or tablets per batch. Trial and stability batches are much smaller, and we quote those separately.
faqSamplesA: Yes. Once a mutual non-disclosure agreement is in place we produce a sample batch with a full analytical report and retained samples.
faqExportA: We prepare certificates of analysis, GMP certificates and shipping documentation in-house, and work with your appointed freight partner.
